profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. is a Toronto-based public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. According to its own site, it engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. The company says its global network and team help customers achieve a competitive advantage.

The material available on Celestica's AI position is limited to these self-descriptions. Its site presents AI and cloud infrastructure as central to what it builds, but no specific AI products are named in the available information, and no lawsuits, MCP servers or other registry entries are recorded for the company.
